name: Esther Salas
service_line_reviewed: Article III service reviewed: 2011–13 September 2026. Selected decisions: 1.

biography.text: Born in 1968 in Los Angeles. Salas received a B.A. from Rutgers University (1991) and a J.D. from Rutgers Law School–Newark (1994). She clerked in New Jersey Superior Court, practiced privately, served as an assistant federal public defender, and was a District of New Jersey magistrate judge from 2006 until her elevation by President Obama.

other_writings.text: Salas has authored public-facing commentary on judicial security, including the New York Times Opinion video “When Judges Are Attacked, You Suffer” (2025).
